h: GehGeh withdraws support for Delta Governor Oborevwori, cites mother's death
p: Social commentator GehGeh has reportedly withdrawn his endorsement of Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori. He blamed poor healthcare in his community for his mother's death and said Peter Obi remains his presidential choice.
body: Social commentator and content creator GehGeh has reportedly withdrawn his earlier support for Delta State Governor Sheriff Oborevwori's re-election bid.

GehGeh said he lost his mother on 8 December 2024, and blamed the lack of adequate healthcare facilities in his community and neighbouring areas as a major cause of her death. He said he was ashamed to have previously endorsed the governor and asked his followers to forgive him.
He also questioned what the state government was doing to tackle youth unemployment.
GehGeh added that Peter Obi of the NDC remains his preferred presidential candidate for 2027.
No response from the Delta State government or the governor's campaign was included in the reports.
more: GehGeh blames poor healthcare for his mother's death.
He questioned youth unemployment in Delta.
He says Peter Obi is still his candidate.
